results.desc: Historial de ventas por empresa, ordenado por fecha desc (paginado típico)
results.sql:
SELECT id, date, total, status, user_id, payment_method, client_name, client_id
          FROM sales WHERE company_id = ? ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50

results.desc: Filtro por método de pago dentro de una empresa
results.sql:
SELECT id, date, total FROM sales
          WHERE company_id = ? AND payment_method = ?
          ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 50

results.desc: Ventas de un usuario en rango (turnos / cierre de caja)
results.sql:
SELECT * FROM sales
          WHERE company_id = ? AND user_id = ? AND date BETWEEN ? AND ?

results.desc: Lotes activos por producto ordenados por vencimiento (FEFO)
results.sql:
SELECT id, expiry_date, quantity FROM product_lots
          WHERE company_id = ? AND product_id = ? AND quantity > 0
          ORDER BY expiry_date

plan.detail: SEARCH product_lots USING INDEX idx_product_lots_product (product_id=? AND quantity>?)
